def solve(i):
    H,W=len(i),len(i[0])
    # find bands: rows with any nonzero
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(i[r])]
    bands=[];cur=[rows[0]]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: bands.append(cur);cur=[r]
    bands.append(cur)
    assert len(bands)==2, bands
    # reference band = one whose cells reach the right edge
    def lastcol(b): return max(j for r in b for j,v in enumerate(i[r]) if v)
    ref,tr = (bands[0],bands[1]) if lastcol(bands[0])>=lastcol(bands[1]) else (bands[1],bands[0])
    dh = tr[0]-ref[0]  # offset between bands
    # best shift s: tr(r,c) ~ ref(r-dh, c-s)
    best=max(((sum(1 for r in tr for c in range(W) if i[r][c] and 0<=c-s<W and i[r-dh][c-s]==i[r][c]),

    cut = max(c for r in tr for c,v in enumerate(i[r]) if v)+1
